text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! There's so much!
Not bad, familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still, aren't you just fluffy and cute! You look so happy that I won you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I decided not to use a scapegoat doll after all.
Even without a doll to take the fall for me,
I can do everything by myself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if push comes to shove, I can just use you, my familiar,
as a scapegoat! I'm going to display these little guys in my room!
